# Policy: Corporate Records Policy
**Policy ID:** POL-001  
**Version:** 1.0 (Approved)  
**Owner:** Corporate Compliance Manager  

> SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for DocBrain tests. A fictional organizational policy, not legislation.

## 1. Commitment
Operational records are kept in the records system for the period set by the applicable rules or permit.
Where no rule or permit sets a period, the retention period is an open gap for the Compliance Manager.
